data.name: Enaam
data.long_meaning: Giver of Trust, Confident, Strong, Supportive, Comfort, Calmness, Assurance, Protection
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to those who are trustworthy and have the ability to instill confidence in others. It is a name that signifies strength and support, and those who bear it are believed to be calm, assuring, and protective.
data.numerology_meaning: A master builder, a visionary, and a dynamic force. The number 11 is a Master Number, and represents intuition, insight, and the ability to see the big picture.

in_arabic.name: إينام
in_arabic.meaning: إينام يعني العطاء والنعمة والفضل من الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: إينام هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع-ن-م' والذي يحمل معاني العطاء والنعمة والفضل. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن نعم الله على عباده. يعتبر إينام من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الشكر والامتنان لله على عطائه

in_urdu.name: عینام
in_urdu.meaning: عینام مطلب ہے اللہ کی نعمت اور فضل
in_urdu.long_meaning: عینام ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ع-ن-م' کے جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی نعمت، فضل، اور عطاء۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں اس کا بڑا احترام ہے

in_hindi.name: ऐनाम
in_hindi.meaning: ऐनाम का अर्थ है भगवान की कृपा और आशीर्वाद
in_hindi.long_meaning: ऐनाम एक अरबी नाम है जो 'अ-न-म' मूल से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है भगवान की कृपा, आशीर्वाद और उपहार। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत पसंद किया जाता है और इसे पारंपरिक महत्व प्राप्त है

in_pashto.name: عينام
in_pashto.meaning: عينام دالله د نعمت او فضل معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عينام د عربي ژبې يو نوم دی چي د 'ع-ن-م' ريښې څخه اخيستل شوی دی. دا نوم د الله د نعمت، فضل او عطا په معنا دی. په افغانستان او پښتونستان کې ددې نوم ډیر استعمال دی او د اسلامي دود په منځ کې یې لوی احترام دی

in_english.name: Enaam
in_english.meaning: Enaam means gift, blessing, or favor from Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Enaam is an Arabic name derived from the root 'a-n-m', signifying gift, blessing, or favor. Referenced in the Quran in contexts discussing Allah's favors upon His servants. Enaam symbolizes gratitude and acknowledgment of Allah's generosity

data.cultural_impact: The name "Enaam" (انعام) has its roots in the Arabic language and is commonly used among Muslims. It holds a positive association due to its meaning, which is closely linked to trust, confidence, and strength. In Islamic culture, trust and faith in Allah (God) and His guidance are highly valued, and the name "Enaam" can be seen as a reflection of these virtues. It is also associated with the idea of providing support and protection, which is a vital role for family members and the community in Islamic teachings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Enaam" holds a significant message of reassurance and calmness in uncertain times. The faith and trust that the name embodies represent a deep connection to the divine and a sense of spiritual security. It is a reminder that Allah is the ultimate giver of trust and that with faith and confidence in Him, one can find guidance, protection, and strength. The name "Enaam" also symbolizes the importance of being supportive and comforting to others, reflecting the compassionate nature of Islam and the desire to create a harmonious and engaged community.
